title: La escuela
goal: Be asked to say hello to a class in English
culture: A foreigner walking past a school is a free English lesson and she will ask. Saying yes costs five minutes and buys you the whole street; saying no is fine too, but say it as a no to today rather than a no to her.

beats.say: No soy maestro, pero sí hablo inglés.
beats.en: I’m not a teacher, but I do speak English.
ok: no soy maestro pero si hablo ingles
beats.good: Correct the assumption and answer the real question in the same breath. She is not asking for your credentials.

beats.es: ¿Y no me les habla tantito a los chavalos? Cinco minutos.
beats.good: Con mucho gusto is a warm yes and it is used constantly here — for favours, for introductions, for handing somebody the salt.

beats.objective: Ask what to say to them
beats.en: And what should I say to them?
beats.good: Ask before you are in front of thirty children. She has a plan and she will tell you in four words.

beats.es: Cualquier cosa. Salúdelos y que le oigan el acento.
beats.say: Está bien. Una vez nada más.
ok: esta bien una vez nada mas
beats.good: Una vez nada más sets the limit while still saying yes. Without it you are the English teacher of Xalteva by Friday.
